verdict.rationale: Dropbox's Platform API documents OAuth-based authorization with 'Customizing scopes in the OAuth app authorization flow,' enabling developers (including agent builders) to request only the permissions an app needs rather than full account access. However, there is no agent-specific guidance, no documentation of short-lived/rotating tokens, granular per-resource scoping beyond app-level OAuth scopes, or admin tooling for auditing/issuing scoped credentials specifically for AI agents. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance guidance, fine-grained resource-level scoping beyond OAuth app scopes, token lifecycle/rotation controls, and independent corroboration of least-privilege enforcement in practice.
